bio-text: Holding a Master's in Information Science and a Bachelor's in Archival Science from the Federal University of Bahia, Ricardo is a civil servant at UFBA, currently seconded to the National Archives of Brazil, where he serves as Head of the Northeast Regional Office. His career focuses on archival management, technical treatment of archival information, and the development of access, dissemination, and innovation initiatives. He has expertise in archival description, information representation, and the development of digital platforms for access to archival collections, including projects using artificial intelligence. He works at the intersection of Archival Science, Digital Humanities, access to information, hacker culture, and technologies applied to archives.
